'''Hunn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where he controlled the operation of [[Gorinth Brig|Cave 52]], and contacted an Imperial aligned individual who attacked it via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hunn is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
